purpose: Offline full re-evaluation after the active v15 full4 and v18 gates terminate

arms.accuracy: v18 only if its preregistered gate accepts, otherwise v15 exact-speed v11 descendant

evaluators.humaneval: frozen LocalLeap sanitizer and execution evaluator
evaluators.localleap_math500: Prism-aligned frozen prompt and answer normalizer
evaluators.mbpp: prompt-visible assertions only, independent execution crosscheck, no hidden tests

fairness_invariants: same current-server runtime for all three arms
same checkpoint and all weight hashes
same stable ids, raw prompts, documents, targets and evaluator versions
same actual chat-rendered input text and token-id hashes
same decoding budget except algorithm-induced NFE changes
no historical old-server result is used as the formal comparator
fallback: retain the unified v11 family; do not synthesize a per-task ensemble
paper_values: report separately only; never use paper-reported values as local records
